Jérôme d'Ambrosio raced for Virgin in 2011 and Lotus F1 in 2012. Across those seasons his teammates were Timo Glock (2011), and Kimi Räikkönen and Romain Grosjean (2012). Only Räikkönen won a drivers' championship in the 2000–2025 window, taking the 2007 title with Ferrari. Glock and Grosjean did not win one.

ANSWER: Kimi Räikkönen
